tools.name: agent_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an agent: interrupts the active provider turn, tears down its owned process tree and revokes its delegation token.

tools.name: agent_capabilities
tools.description: Report delegation providers, permission profiles, limits, recovery semantics and protocol details.

tools.name: agent_cleanup
tools.description: Archive terminal agent records; confirm=delete_artifacts also removes managed worktrees and delegated homes.

tools.name: agent_events
tools.description: Read the tamper-evident lifecycle event log for an agent, paged by cursor.

tools.name: agent_fork
tools.description: Fork an agent's provider thread into a new agent sharing history; optionally start it on a new task.

tools.name: agent_list
tools.description: List agents for this project scope (or all project scopes when project is omitted).

tools.name: agent_result
tools.description: Read an agent's final result, files changed and token usage; wait_ms long-polls until the turn resolves.

tools.name: agent_resume
tools.description: Recover an interrupted or failed agent: respawns the provider session and reattaches its durable thread, optionally starting a new turn.

tools.name: agent_send
tools.description: Steer a running agent's active turn, or start a new turn on an idle/completed agent.

tools.name: agent_spawn
tools.description: Create and start a delegated provider sub-agent bound to this project. Authority (workspace, sandbox profile, budgets, lineage) is bound server-side; dedupe_key returns the same agent for safe retries.

tools.name: agent_status
tools.description: Read an agent's durable state; wait_ms long-polls until a result-bearing state. include may add events, result, provider detail.

tools.name: archive_terminal_jobs
tools.description: Archive only older terminal job receipts for this project scope into durable LocalControl history. Active jobs and recent terminal receipts are retained; safe to repeat.

tools.name: capabilities
tools.description: Report registered, enabled and client-observed capabilities.

tools.name: collection_inventory
tools.description: List bounded metadata for direct children of one authorized collection; never reads arbitrary file contents.

tools.name: efficiency_metrics
tools.description: Report LocalControl broker/read call and byte counters; never invents model tokens.

tools.name: exec
tools.description: Start one owned job. In the project_sandbox class (exec_mode=appcontainer) arbitrary absolute-path argv - including the governed PowerShell executable - runs autonomously inside the enrolled workspace with no per-command approval; never elevated. This ownership candidate supports Windows AppContainer execution only; recipes and trusted_local configurations are rejected at startup. Waits for short jobs.

tools.name: file_delete
tools.description: Delete one regular file inside a writable project. Requires its observed SHA-256 and a unique request ID. Never deletes directories.

tools.name: file_list
tools.description: List safe direct children. No credential/control directories or reparse targets.

tools.name: file_patch
tools.description: Exact occurrence-checked patch with optimistic concurrency. dry_run returns without mutation.

tools.name: file_read
tools.description: Read bounded UTF-8 lines and a SHA-256 for future edits.

tools.name: file_search
tools.description: Bounded literal text search, skipping protected and linked files.

tools.name: file_write
tools.description: Create or replace one file atomically. Requires an observed SHA-256 or absent, and a unique request ID.

tools.name: health_status
tools.description: Read current LocalControl health plus durable trusted supervisor telemetry.

tools.name: job_delta
tools.description: Read only newly captured output from one owned job.

tools.name: job_input
tools.description: Queue bounded stdin to an owned interactive job. Delivery to application is not acknowledged.

tools.name: job_read
tools.description: Read an owned job result, optionally long-polling for completion. view=summary skips captured output and returns structured state only (use job_delta for output).

tools.name: job_stop
tools.description: Stop only a job created by this server and scope. Never accepts a PID or process name.

tools.name: localcontrol_context
tools.description: Zero-knowledge bootstrap. Call this first: returns authorized projects/scopes, tool groups, features, workflows and health. No arguments needed; project is never guessed.

tools.name: maintenance_begin
tools.description: Acquire an expiring LocalControl-only mutation lease across authorized scopes. Refuses active owned jobs.

tools.name: maintenance_end
tools.description: Release a matching maintenance lease; replay-safe.

tools.name: mission_begin
tools.description: Create a durable mission bound to the workspace identity, an immutable authority snapshot and explicit resource budgets. Completion is never granted by the caller; only the independent verifier may mark it SUCCEEDED.

tools.name: mission_cancel
tools.description: Cancel an owned mission (or abandon it with takeover when the lease is stale).

tools.name: mission_checkpoint
tools.description: Advance mission notes/evidence and lease with an owned token and optional expected revision guard.

tools.name: mission_finish
tools.description: Request completion. Moves the mission to VERIFYING; the deterministic verifier evaluates the success contract and only it can commit SUCCEEDED.

tools.name: mission_resume
tools.description: Resume an interrupted or waiting mission after re-classifying workspace identity. Non-same divergence must be explicitly accepted.

tools.name: mission_schedule
tools.description: Create, list, inspect or cancel durable schedules for queued, delayed, recurring, dependency-bound and retried missions.

tools.name: mission_status
tools.description: Read mission state, evidence, verification and schedules. Omit mission_id to list missions and schedules.

tools.name: process_list
tools.description: List this scope's job receipts, not the host process table.

tools.name: project_discovery_candidates
tools.description: Read bounded sanitized candidates from the operator-owned metadata-only discovery report.

tools.name: project_move_apply
tools.description: Apply one exact signed same-volume move under its lease. Warning codes must be acknowledged exactly.

tools.name: project_move_plan
tools.description: Build an expiring signed same-volume directory-move plan after bounded dependency and reparse risk scanning.

tools.name: project_move_reconcile
tools.description: Reconcile an interrupted move from durable journal plus Windows filesystem identity; never blindly retries rename.

tools.name: project_move_rollback
tools.description: Rollback only when destination identity and full tree fingerprint prove it is the original source.

tools.name: project_move_status
tools.description: Read durable state for one move plan without mutating it.

tools.name: read_batch
tools.description: Read up to 32 bounded text ranges or SHA-256 observations (stat=true) with change-aware response suppression.

tools.name: run_begin
tools.description: Create or explicitly resume a supervised run bound to the workspace identity. Resume classifies divergence and requires accept_divergence when it is not 'same'.

tools.name: run_finish
tools.description: Explicitly finish an owned run. Completion is never inferred; interrupted runs must be resumed before finishing.

tools.name: run_heartbeat
tools.description: Renew the run lease with an owned token and optionally merge bounded progress notes.

tools.name: run_status
tools.description: Read bounded supervised-run state, tamper-evident history and optional telemetry for the run.

tools.name: state_backup
tools.description: Create, list, verify or inspect verified backups of authoritative LocalControl state.

tools.name: state_restore
tools.description: Stage a verified restore of authoritative state. The staged restore is applied idempotently at the next LocalControl start, before any store opens.

tools.name: system_info
tools.description: Inspect enabled capabilities and safety mode. Omit project for the global catalog.

tools.name: task_begin
tools.description: Create an exact-path task ownership ledger entry.

tools.name: task_checkpoint
tools.description: Advance durable task notes with an expected revision guard. Notes accept objective, phase, decisions, completed, blocked_checks, blockers, next_action, vcs, inferences, untested.

tools.name: task_cleanup_apply
tools.description: Apply the guarded task-owned cleanup plan under the verified lease. Never deletes directories.

tools.name: task_cleanup_plan
tools.description: Plan cleanup of task-owned files under a verified maintenance lease.

tools.name: task_create_file
tools.description: Create one task-authorized file through the original guarded file_write broker.

tools.name: task_handoff
tools.description: Return bounded durable task state for safe continuation. include=["environment"] adds observed jobs, leases, unresolved moves/transactions and usage.

tools.name: telemetry_summary
tools.description: Read durable per-operation telemetry (summary, delta since a sequence, or bounded records). Totals survive restarts; unknown model-token fields stay null.

tools.name: transaction_apply
tools.description: Apply one signed transaction plan. All operations commit or the applied prefix is compensated; partial application is never reported as success.

tools.name: transaction_plan
tools.description: Preflight and journal a bounded multi-file transaction (create/replace/patch/delete) with exact SHA guards; returns a signed plan token.

tools.name: transaction_reconcile
tools.description: Resolve an interrupted or indeterminate transaction from the durable journal and observed file state. strategy=rollback (default) compensates; strategy=forward completes remaining operations under their exact guards.

tools.name: transaction_rollback
tools.description: Reverse an applied transaction only when current file state still matches the applied result.

tools.name: transaction_status
tools.description: Read durable transaction state, observed file states and recovery hint.

tools.name: usage_summary
tools.description: Read durable normalized token usage imported only by trusted local adapters, grouped by task/model/stage.

tools.name: workspace_catalog
tools.description: Show the signed operator-authorized workspace and maintenance-collection catalog.

provenance: Frozen before CI from exact reviewed candidate make_tools metadata; this is a static contract, not runtime evidence
